products.name: Amira Learning
products.note: Found in the research for The AI Ready School; not independently verified. AI: Speech recognition tutoring in English and Spanish. Use: AI reading tutor, fluency assessment, dyslexia screening. Who: Students PreK to 8, teachers. Student age: PreK to 8 students rostered by the district; vendor states COPPA compliance. Privacy: District data privacy agreements (signed example in SDPC registry, Scottsdale USD, 2024); vendor states student data is not sent to public AI models. In June 2026 a Portland board member questioned contract data fields such as place of birth and migrant status, and New Mexico let districts opt out of voice recording. Price: Screener $4.99 per student; full suite $20 per student (California state filing, 2024); some states fund free access. Caution: Vendor-cited research; see Chapter 6 evidence notes.
